title: Little Boy on Brick Steps in Garden, May 1950 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming black and white snapshot from May 1950 featuring a young boy seated outside on a multi-tiered brick staircase next to a sunlit bush. The boy squints slightly against the bright outdoor daylight while wearing mid-century children's attire: a button-down shirt layered under a novelty patterned sweater vest, dark trousers, and white shoes. The deckled-edge photograph captures the quintessence of post-World War II American domestic life and childhood in an emerging suburban neighborhood.
